_about: The 2.5D side-view test (v4/side-view-test, scripts/side_mode.gd). Camera: beside the lane, long lens, eased. Lane: the strip the protagonist walks; he may step `depth` metres towards or away from the camera, and is pulled back softly. Fight: the heavy feel — hit-stop, shake, stagger.

lane._about: depth: how far he may stand off the lane line, towards or away from the lens. pull: how hard he is eased back to it. edge: how far before the ends of the strip he is stopped.

fight._about: Grounded and heavy. hit_stop: seconds the world freezes on a landed hit; shake: camera trauma; the rest is the shared combat data.
